$comment: Payment methods that pass verify:gateway-conformance offline but have not passed their whole lifecycle in the gateway's sandbox, real webhooks included: gateway -> method -> { reason, planRef }. A listed method is not offered: no new setups, and buyers do not see it on checkout, portal or pay now. Methods already saved keep charging. Keys are catalog method keys (advertisedMethods, or apple_pay on a gateway with applePayHosted); verify:gateway-conformance fails on a key the catalog does not have. Remove the entry when the method is proven live. See scripts/conformance/README.md.

sepa_debit.reason: Adyen deactivated SEPA Direct Debit on the test merchant account, so no live sandbox debit has run.

us_bank_account.reason: The Microform payment form takes cards only. It does not show the ACH authorization text yet.

apple_pay.reason: The Hosted Payments Page Apple Pay flow needs Safari and an Apple sandbox tester account.

bank_transfer.reason: A net banking mandate has not passed in the PayU test environment.

apple_pay.reason: The Square Sandbox does not show Apple Pay on checkout pages.
